out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed raw chicken thawing in hand sink next to prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE CHICKEN TO PREP SINK TO CONTINUE THAWING. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNER TO EDUCATE ALL STAFF THAT HAND SINKS ARE FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: RAW SHELL EGG MIXTURE IN ICE BATH OBSERVED AT 63F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EMPLOYEE MOVED RAW SHELL EGG MIXTURE TO 2 DR PREP - RIGHT TO BEGIN COOLING PROCESS, SINCE EGG MIXTURE NO LONGER IN USE. EHS EDUCATED STAFF THAT CONTAINER OF TCS FOOD MUST BE SUBMERGED IN ICE BATH TO MAINTAIN PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURE OF <=41F. OWNER INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEES TO KEEP EGG MIXTURE IN PREP UNIT.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: fried chicken patty. Observed employee using gloved hand to slice fried chicken patty and then use other non-gloved hand to scoop chicken into bowl.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EHS discussed with CFM that no barehand contact with ready to eat food is permitted. CFM will reeducate staff that gloves should be worn or utensils used when handling ready to eat food.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: soup prepared 3 days ago in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS discussed with CFM that ALL foods kept more than 24 hours must be date marked.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observed glue board with dead pests.
violations.corrective_action: EHS discussed with CFM that premises should be regularly inspected for pests and if they observe dead pests on glue boards to discard immediately and notify pest control company. Kimen (Inspection Date: 04/14/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: #4 2 dr prep.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM stated repair has been completed, but they are monitoring unit’s temperature before storing any food. Any food in unit is being held on ice. CFM will call for repairs if unit is unable to maintain cold holding temperature of 41F or below.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed gaps in ceilings and walls throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Seal gaps along establishment perimeter to prevent any potential pest issue.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed odor emitting from grease trap.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS recommended CFM have grease trap cleaned.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels provided at hand sink near register.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC provided paper towels.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell eggs on shelf above soups in WIC, observed container of raw pork on shelf above RTE noodles in #3.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM will move eggs to bottom shelf. EHS assisted in moving pork to bottom shelf of #3.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 0 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. EHS assisted in troubleshooting dish machine by priming sanitizer line. Chlorine observed at 50-100ppm. EHS educated CFM and PIC that sanitizer concentration must be checked before using dish machine.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the sanitizer basin of the 3 compartment sink with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. EHS educated PIC and CFM on proper concentration of chlorine required for manual WAREWASHING.Chlorine observed between 50-100ppm. Kimen (Inspection Date: 10/07/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: pork soup on stovetop at 131F, chicken soup on stovetop at 131F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS had CFM reheat pork soup and chicken soup to 181F and 166F, respectively. EHS educated CFM and PIC that hot holding foods must be kept at 135F or higher.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed scrambled egg mix on prep table at 44F in ice bath.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS had CFM replenish ice, as most ice was observed melted. EHS educated CFM that food on ice must be kept at 41F or below.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. Observed can of residential pest spray in back of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CFM discarded residential pest spray. Pest control should be contacted for any pest issues in the food establishment.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unlabeled spray bottle with cleaner hanging on cart.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC labelled spray bottle with cleaner name.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM present during entirety of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. A follow up inspection will occur on or around 10 days to verify a CFM is present. EHS recommends additional staff obtain CFM certification.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed employee drinking/eating from an open cup with a spoon.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS notified management and requested they notify employees of proper eating, drinking areas.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Observed no paper towels at front hand sink and back kitchen hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. Employee provided paper towels.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw chicken and raw pork stored on shelf above RTE eel and employee food in REF/FRZ; raw shell eggs on shelf above stock pots of soup in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS notified management to follow proper storage order in units. All cooked and RTE foods should be placed on top shelves and raw meats on below shelving following cooking temperature.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw chicken stored over raw pork in REF/FRZ.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS notified management to move raw chicken to bottom of unit.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Observed spray bottle of degreaser stored in same container as bottles of various RTE sauces on shelf under prep table next to REF/FRZ.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. Remove spray bottle of degreaser and move to chemical storage area in back of kitchen near exit door.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottle of cleaner at front counter near register with no label of chemical name.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. Label all spray bottles with content’s name.

out_items.name: Thermometers provided and accurate

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: REF/FRZ.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PURCHASE AND PLACE THERMOMETER IN UNIT TO BE ABLE TO MONITOR PROPER COLD HOLDING TEMPERATURES.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: various sauces and oils in squirt bottles at cook line; bulk containers of rice, starches, sugars in dry storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Label all secondary containers with food name. Kimen (Inspection Date: 04/08/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food on floor of WIC and WIF.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Move all foods to shelving units.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping clothes stored on counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EHS notified management to store all wet wiping clothes in bleach sanitizer solution.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Observed rice scoop, spoons stored in room temperature water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS notified management of proper storage for in-use utensils.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Handled Single-Service/Use Items Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped forks were not stored at the front counter with the handles up.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. EHS notified management of proper storage of single-service forks.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: particle board planks next to flat top at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS notified management to remove particle board from kitchen.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a bleach test kit.
